{"items":[{"ref":"E04","coverage_id":"coverage-ab1b067aed64b930","coverage_title":"BR1：核对页返回选择的状态保留","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ2明确要求返回时保留选择；已提供返回前后及再次核对证据，可按实际时段与服务台逐项对照。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-54c27ab204c6479384eced085b8c3114","ev-4a119973f66c4bb5823812d82b6658dd","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["BR1","action-a56ac1f20a424c7eab29d05465d80848","action-40ff433955dd4936bce073fd09145a66"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0","obj-2ba5c91c54257c9ca213"],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"E04","coverage_id":"coverage-174d74576132ebc4","coverage_title":"BR3：刷新或重新开始后的复位","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ4明确复位至选择页；现有初始页不能替代复位动作及结果，且未规定复位后必须默认选中哪个时段。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-ed5981943d36420abcbcfb932f3a6a84"],"evidence_needed":["复位前状态、实际复位动作及复位后选择页；分别记录所测试的复位方式"],"object_refs":["BR3","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":["REQ4"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"E05","coverage_id":"coverage-237f678a4a1bd310","coverage_title":"TASK1：登记流程异常与恢复条件","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"材料提供正常路径，未明确异常条件及恢复要求；不能以尚未遇错认定不存在异常分支。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["明确异常设计或实际异常及触发条件","预期恢复方式与可安全测试条件","若适用，恢复动作前后观察"],"object_refs":["TASK1","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"3c57d1bfeec301a5061a3aac","coverage_title":"选择页：任务信息与页眉页脚的层级","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"TASK1及REQ1明确选择任务，完整截图包含选项、操作入口及页眉页脚，可检查外围内容是否挤占关键信息。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-ed5981943d36420abcbcfb932f3a6a84"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["page-7a7cb16c558de9c4","3c57d1bfeec301a5061a3aac"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34","coverage_title":"核对页：核对内容及提交入口的层级","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"最新截图完整呈现核对内容、返回与提交入口及页眉页脚，可按TASK1检查外围内容是否干扰核对和提交。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["page-7a7cb16c558de9c4","d26ef33e7cf79b4071dfdc34"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0","obj-96d6f72e97ca58664da8"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"coverage-23c64aec5c8661f5","coverage_title":"BR2：完成页登记结果的呈现层级","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"REQ3明确完成页所需信息，但提交尚待执行，未取得完成页内容与竞争区域，不能预判其层级。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["提交后的完整完成页截图与实际内容"],"object_refs":["BR2","action-6a0cb99a000d4b1fb341f4c859bfd25a"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","observation"]},{"ref":"R21","coverage_id":"coverage-237f678a4a1bd310","coverage_title":"TASK1：登记流程异常与恢复条件","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"尚无明确错误状态及错误范围；正常选择与核对截图不能证明全流程不存在错误提示对象。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287"],"evidence_ids":["ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["明确错误状态、完整提示及相关字段或操作范围"],"object_refs":["TASK1","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation"]},{"ref":"R22","coverage_id":"coverage-237f678a4a1bd310","coverage_title":"TASK1：登记流程异常与恢复条件","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"错误对象及用户可执行的修正方式尚未确定，不能据正常页面缺少修正说明形成问题。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["明确错误及可修正性依据","错误提示和关联帮助或恢复说明的完整内容"],"object_refs":["TASK1","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation","statement"]},{"ref":"R23","coverage_id":"coverage-237f678a4a1bd310","coverage_title":"TASK1：登记流程异常与恢复条件","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"未取得错误原文，目标用户背景也未提供；不能推定用户为非技术人员或判定错误语言可理解。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["实际错误提示完整原文","与提示理解有关的目标用户背景"],"object_refs":["TASK1","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["observation","statement"]},{"ref":"R24","coverage_id":"coverage-237f678a4a1bd310","coverage_title":"TASK1：关键步骤的解释需要与帮助","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"任务步骤已知，但用户知识及必须解释的复杂对象未确认；不能因界面简洁判不适用，也不能因无帮助入口报问题。","source_ids":["src-d26f1061d5dc4b26971c209b4af54287","src-1c9ca6d9af5f4f799be4a24b882ebb31"],"evidence_ids":["ev-2f97d5fc719c439b842ad62d0c01670a","ev-5bb645c490a9466e9d64fd29d0c2d8ab"],"evidence_needed":["目标用户知识与关键步骤解释需要的依据","若确认需要，相关步骤的说明及关联帮助实际内容"],"object_refs":["TASK1","page-7a7cb16c558de9c4"],"object_ids":["obj-91d36b9f4dbc6cbcf6c0"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["statement","observation"]}]}
